content.title: Materialise (NasdaqGS:MTLS) Net Margin Falls to 1.7%, Challenging Bullish Profitability Narratives
content.summary: Materialise (NasdaqGS:MTLS) reported that revenue growth is expected at 7% per year, which trails the broader US market’s 10.2% annual average. The company’s net profit margin narrowed to 1.7%, dropping noticeably from last year’s 3.8%. While Materialise has averaged an impressive 27.5% annual earnings growth over the last five years, recent results show a return to negative earnings growth. This undermines the near-term outlook and leaves limited visibility on short-term profit trends...
